context: Whole group gathers around an old photo album; many memories.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 皆、この写真、振り返ってみて。
lines.en: Everyone — look back at this photo for a moment.
lines.style: Soft, warm opening. A gentle gathering-in rather than a command. Tender regard underneath, the voice of someone holding something precious. Pause before "look back" — she's inviting them to settle in.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ふふ、長年の思い出、ようけ詰まっとる。
lines.en: Ha — so many years of memories packed in here.
lines.style: Small, knowing laugh at the start. Slow, deliberate pace. Kansai warmth — conversational, not performing. Lingers on the satisfaction of "packed in," the weight of time held lightly.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 深く愛情、感じるね、皆と。
lines.en: You can feel so much love in this, can't you — all of us together.
lines.style: Tender, almost reverent. Soft attack on "feel." The words come like she's discovering them as she speaks. Warm but still — not effusive, more like noticing something true about the room.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 時代、ようけ流れたなぁ。
lines.en: Time sure has flowed through us, hasn't it.
lines.style: Quiet reflection. Kansai lilt underneath — warm, not heavy. Let the words settle. Slight trailing-off at the end, like he's watching the current of years pass. Soft, almost to himself.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I was so tiny back then!
lines.style: Bright, genuinely amazed at his own smallness. Quick, young energy — not performing wonder, actually feeling it. Light on the exclamation, like discovery rather than announcement.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: おばあちゃん、若いとき、綺麗!
lines.en: Grandma looked so pretty when she was young!
lines.style: Genuine admiration, no filter. Bright but sincere — not flattery, just honest observation. Quick and warm. The kind of thing a child notices and actually says aloud.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ふふ、感謝の毎日、本当に。
lines.en: Ha — I'm grateful every single day, truly.
lines.style: Soft laugh, slight exhale. Humble tone — not proud, but genuine. Her voice carries the weight of meaning what she says. Tender, without being fragile. Like she's confirming something she already knows.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 皆おって、ええ家族や、ほんま。
lines.en: With all of you here — that's what makes a real family, truly.
lines.style: Warm Kansai cadence. Steady conviction, not sentimental. Small pause after "here," like he's looking around. Pride underneath, but expressed as simple fact. The voice of someone who knows what matters.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 振り返ると、感謝、いっぱい。
lines.en: When I look back like this, I feel so much gratitude.
lines.style: Soft, steady voice. Not rushed — each word gets its weight. Tender but not fragile. The kind of moment where someone is genuinely moved but still present, still clear.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: これからも、皆と、過ごしような。
lines.en: Let's keep doing this together — all of us, going forward.
lines.style: Warm commitment. Kansai warmth underneath. Not a promise he's making lightly — there's weight to it. Open-hearted but grounded. Like he's saying something he means to hold.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I love all of you so much!
lines.style: Pure, bright sincerity from a child. No performance, no hesitation. Quick and warm and genuine. The kind of thing that stops a room for a good reason.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: こうやって、長く、続けてほしい。
lines.en: I want us to keep going like this forever — just like this.
lines.style: Quiet wish, not demand. Tender and sincere underneath her brightness. Slight vulnerability — she's asking for something she cares about. Slow, careful delivery. Trailing hope at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: Family is treasure — so much treasure.
lines.style: Warm, simple truth. Slow pace, like she's stating something fundamental. Tender but firm — this is what she knows. Quiet satisfaction at the end, like placing something precious down and knowing it's safe.
